title: The Hymn of the Ninth Floor
author: Yara Halloran
blurb: Ada Okafor, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
